name: 250 Mouthwatering Vegan Recipes Cookbook
summary: A plant-based recipe cookbook with 250 vegan dishes aimed at easy, everyday cooking.
best_for: Readers exploring a vegan or plant-based diet who want a large, easy-to-follow recipe library.

name: 1 Month Vegan Challenge
summary: A 28-day structured vegan challenge with a meal plan and recipes meant to guide beginners through their first month of plant-based eating.
best_for: People who want a guided, day-by-day plan to try veganism rather than figuring it out on their own.

name: Plant-Based For Kids
niche: vegan recipes and meal plans for children
summary: A vegan cookbook built for families, with kid-friendly plant-based recipes, age-based meal plans, and allergy-friendly options.
best_for: Plant-based parents looking for recipes their kids will actually eat, including picky eaters and food allergies.

name: The Travel Hacker's Toolkit
niche: budget travel and travel hacking strategies
summary: A guide of travel-hacking strategies and tools aimed at helping everyday travelers afford luxury-style trips on a modest budget.
best_for: Budget-conscious travelers who want practical tactics for cheaper flights, points, and travel deals.

name: Backyard Eggs = Big Bucks!
niche: backyard chicken keeping and egg-selling side income
summary: A DIY guide showing how to raise backyard chickens and turn surplus eggs into a small side income.
best_for: Homeowners with yard space who are curious about backyard chickens as both a hobby and a modest income source.

name: Pencil Drawing Made Easy
summary: A video-based pencil drawing course with over 40 hours of instruction aimed at taking beginners from basics to realistic sketches.
best_for: Aspiring artists and hobbyists who want a structured, self-paced way to learn pencil drawing from scratch.
